name: manager-mcp
description: MCP server for Manager.io bookkeeping: read-first with opt-in scoped task and write tools. Requires uv on PATH.

api_url.title: Manager API URL
api_url.description: Instance root including /api2 when required (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:55667/api2).

api_key.title: Manager API key
api_key.description: Access token from Manager Settings → Access Tokens (sent as X-API-KEY).

write_scopes.title: Write scopes
write_scopes.description: Comma-separated domains for create/update: quotes,orders,parties,items,sales,purchases,banking,payroll,ledger,raw. Recommended: banking,sales,parties. Leave empty for read-only.

delete_scopes.title: Delete scopes
delete_scopes.description: Comma-separated domains for delete only. Never implied by write scopes. Leave empty for no deletes.
